feature.title: MoonWaker profile selection, PIN protection, and Windows user switching
feature.objective: Let the Android client select a MoonWaker profile after host selection, show whether it matches the active Windows session, protect selected profiles with an optional four-digit PIN, and explicitly switch Windows users without logging anybody off.
definition_of_done: A host with a selected MoonWaker profile that differs from the active Windows profile is shown with a yellow profile-attention state.
When several authorized profiles exist and no valid automatic app profile is configured, host activation opens a controller-first profile selection screen.
A protected profile requires a valid four-digit PIN before Android persists or enters that profile.
An explicit Windows profile switch disconnects the active console session through Fast User Switching and never logs it off.
Missing Windows sign-in credentials leave the computer at LogonUI and produce an attention-required message.
All affected Android, Gateway, Host Control, Login Broker, and Credential Provider contracts have focused automated coverage and the Windows flow has passed the manual VM matrix.

sources_of_truth.selected_app_profile: Android HostGatewayStore, keyed by host UUID
sources_of_truth.automatic_app_profile: Android HostGatewayStore, keyed by host UUID; this preference selects the app profile and does not silently switch Windows
sources_of_truth.profile_registry_and_device_grants: Machine Gateway registry/configuration managed by Host Control
sources_of_truth.profile_pin_verifier: Machine Gateway profile configuration managed only by elevated Host Control
sources_of_truth.pin_unlock_lease: Ephemeral Gateway memory, bound to paired client and profile

invariants: Windows users are switched by disconnecting the active console session; no logoff API or command may be used.
A profile mismatch never makes an online host appear offline.
Opening or refreshing the host-selection screen never switches the Windows user.
Automatic app-profile selection and Windows-session switching are separate features.
A PIN-protected profile cannot be configured for unattended automatic app login.
Android never stores or logs a profile PIN.
The Gateway never returns a PIN verifier or plaintext PIN to Android.
Profile listing is a presentation aid; use_profile and remote_sign_in grants remain authorization boundaries.
A protected profile's scoped endpoints enforce a valid server-side unlock lease; the PIN is not merely an Android UI lock.
Existing LaunchTransitionController privacy and readiness rules remain unchanged.
PlayIntent remains pinned to one hostId and profileId for its lifetime.
Stale asynchronous results are rejected using host, profile, request, and generation correlation.
Moonlight core is not modified for this feature.

decisions.decision: Use Windows Fast User Switching by disconnecting the active console session, never by logging it off.
decisions.rationale: The previous user's applications and session must remain alive.

decisions.decision: Insert a MoonWaker profile gate between host selection and the host home screen.
decisions.rationale: With multiple profiles and no automatic app profile, the user must choose an identity before profile-scoped data is loaded.

decisions.decision: Model a profile mismatch as a yellow attention state while preserving existing offline, suspended, terminating, and active-stream precedence.
decisions.rationale: The computer is reachable but the selected profile is not ready.

decisions.decision: Automatic app login is a per-host profile preference and does not silently switch Windows.
decisions.rationale: Choosing the app identity and changing the active Windows desktop are distinct user intents.

decisions.decision: Use a PS5-inspired direct controller-to-digit PIN mapping with a focusable numeric keypad fallback for TV remotes.
decisions.rationale: Gamepad entry should not require moving focus between ten keys, while non-gamepad devices must remain usable.

decisions.decision: Verify the four-digit PIN on the Gateway with rate limiting and issue only an ephemeral client/profile unlock lease.
decisions.rationale: A four-digit PIN is a local access gate with low entropy and must not be persisted or enforced only cosmetically on Android.

decisions.decision: Expose Windows switching through a separate explicit session/switch mutation rather than changing session/ensure semantics.
decisions.rationale: Existing launch and warm-up flows must not begin disconnecting an active user as an implicit side effect.

verified_baseline: Android already stores the selected integration profile in HostGatewayStore.
GET /api/v1/profiles already returns authorized profiles with session_state and remote_sign_in_state.
ConsoleActivity already has a profile selector on the host home screen, but not a full-screen gate after host selection.
ConsoleActivity host-selection tiles currently derive color only from Moonlight and session presentation state.
HostLaunchPreflight already drives bounded remote sign-in attempts and treats another active Windows profile as blocking.
MoonWakerLoginBroker already classifies active, locked, connected, disconnected, signed_out, other_user_active, and unknown session states.
Host Control already manages stable SID-backed profiles, remote-sign-in credentials, and per-device use_profile/remote_sign_in grants.
The current architecture documentation explicitly marks automatic user switching as unsupported; it must be updated only after the new flow is validated.

controller_pin_mapping.fallback: A focusable 0-9 keypad for non-gamepad TV remotes plus physical numeric keys

tasks.title: Android read-only profile mismatch presentation
tasks.objective: Use the existing cached profile session_state to show a yellow profile-attention status and expose profile selection from the host options menu.
requirements: Add a pure read-only profile presentation projection derived from HostGatewayStore.ProfileSelection and per-profile session_state.

When the selected profile is other_user_active, signed_out, disconnected, locked, or unknown, show profile attention only if no higher-priority active, retained, suspended, terminating, waking, or offline presentation applies.
For selected Basia with another authorized active profile Gry, show both names; otherwise show Basia and a generic other-profile message.
Use the existing yellow presentation color for profile attention.
Add Wybierz profil MoonWaker to host options when more than one authorized profile exists, reusing the existing profile selection action.
Refresh profile summaries for visible online paired Gateway hosts when the host-selection screen is entered, with bounded in-flight work and stale-result rejection.
Preserve current profile selection and library behavior.
non_goals: No new Gateway or Login Broker contract.
acceptance_criteria: Basia selected plus Basia session_state=other_user_active renders a yellow host/profile-attention state and includes Basia in the status text.
If Gry is an authorized profile with session_state=active, the status identifies PC: Gry and MoonWaker: Basia.
A matching active selected profile retains the normal green online state.
Offline and active-stream states keep their existing colors and labels.
The host options menu opens the existing profile chooser without first entering the host home screen.
Late responses for another host cannot change the focused host's presentation.

tasks.title: Controller-first profile gate and automatic app profile
tasks.objective: Place a PS5-inspired MoonWaker profile selection screen between host selection and host home, and allow an unprotected per-host automatic app profile.
requirements: Do not call the existing selectHost/load-library path until the profile gate resolves.
One usable profile enters directly; several usable profiles without a valid automatic profile show the gate.
Back returns to host selection and restores focus to the same host.
The active Windows profile is marked but never chosen automatically unless it is the configured automatic app profile.
Automatic app-profile selection never switches the Windows user.
Use one focused view component and existing ConsoleActivity callbacks; do not introduce a navigation framework.
acceptance_criteria: Two profiles and no automatic profile always show the profile gate.
A valid automatic profile skips the gate.
A removed or unauthorized automatic profile is cleared and the gate is shown.
No profile-scoped library request runs for the previously selected profile while the gate is unresolved.

tasks.title: Host Fast User Switching operation
tasks.objective: Add an explicit host-side operation that disconnects the active local console session and starts or resumes the selected profile without logging off the previous user.
requirements: Add a dedicated Gateway session/switch mutation with an idempotent request ID.
Require the existing profile and remote-sign-in authorization appropriate to the operation.
Keep disconnect and attempt ownership in MoonWakerLoginBroker.
Use WTSDisconnectSession or the equivalent native WTS API, never logoff or tsdiscon.exe.
Return attention_required when credentials are missing after reaching LogonUI.
Reject RDP, unresolved/multiple active sessions, disabled Fast User Switching, and failed disconnects deterministically.
Do not change the implicit behavior of session/ensure.
acceptance_criteria: Switching from Gry to Basia leaves Gry disconnected with its applications running.
A ready Basia credential completes through the existing Credential Provider attempt flow.
Missing Basia credentials end at LogonUI with attention_required.
A failed disconnect does not issue credentials or start a target attempt.
Repeated use of the same request ID does not disconnect twice.

tasks.title: Android explicit Windows profile switch
tasks.objective: Expose safe profile-alignment actions in the Android host menu and drive the bounded host switch operation.
requirements: Offer Use Gry in MoonWaker when an authorized Gry profile is active on the PC.
Offer Switch Windows user to Basia when Basia is the selected app profile but is not active.
Confirm that the current session will be disconnected and its applications left running.
Map missing credentials to Ekran logowania wymaga uwagi.
Keep Android switch state transient and reject stale host/profile/request results.
Refresh profile status after success, failure, cancellation, or attention_required.
acceptance_criteria: Selecting the active PC profile aligns only MoonWaker and performs no Windows mutation.
Explicit switching aligns Windows to the selected MoonWaker profile.
No host-screen refresh can trigger a switch.
Cancelling or changing host/profile stops polling and cannot update the new selection.

tasks.title: Host Control and Gateway PIN protection
tasks.objective: Let an administrator set, change, or remove a four-digit app PIN per profile and enforce it on the Gateway.
requirements: Host Control labels this as an app PIN, not a Windows password.
Store only a versioned salted verifier in protected machine configuration.
Profile listing exposes pin_required only.
PIN verification is available only to an authenticated paired client with use_profile.
Use constant-time verifier comparison and per-client/profile online rate limiting.
Successful verification creates a short, non-persistent client/profile unlock lease.
Profile-scoped endpoints enforce the lease when pin_required is true.
Enabling PIN invalidates automatic app-profile selection on Android when it is next observed.
acceptance_criteria: No config, response, argument, environment variable, diagnostic, or log contains the plaintext PIN.
Wrong PIN attempts are rate limited without revealing verifier material.
An expired or absent lease blocks protected profile endpoints.
Profiles without PIN preserve existing behavior for current clients.

tasks.title: Android PS5-style PIN entry
tasks.objective: Require and verify a profile PIN from the profile gate using direct controller digit shortcuts and a TV-remote fallback keypad.
requirements: Do not persist selectedIntegrationProfileId until verification succeeds.
Auto-submit after four digits and allow A/Cross to submit.
B/Circle deletes one digit and returns to profile selection when empty.
Never display, persist, diagnose, or log entered digits.
Provide focusable 0-9 entry for non-gamepad devices and accept physical numeric keys.
Show deterministic invalid-PIN and cooldown states.
A PIN-protected profile cannot be saved as the automatic app profile.
acceptance_criteria: A DualSense-compatible controller can enter every digit without moving focus across keypad buttons.
A basic Android TV remote can enter every digit through the focusable keypad.
Wrong PIN leaves the previous app profile selected.
Back navigation is PIN to profile selection to host selection.
Process recreation requires protected profile authorization again.

tasks.title: Integration hardening and Windows VM acceptance
tasks.objective: Validate the complete multi-profile experience and update architecture/support documentation to match proven behavior.
requirements: Run the manual Windows 10/11 matrix for active, locked, signed-out, disconnected, missing-credential, policy-blocked, and service-unavailable states.
Verify the previous user's processes survive every successful switch.
Verify Gateway remains reachable while interactive sessions change.
Verify profile Bridges settle before normal launch readiness continues.
Update MOONWAKER_ARCHITECTURE.md only with behavior proven by tests.
Review diagnostics for accidental account names, PINs, passwords, tokens, or certificate material.
acceptance_criteria: The Basia/Gry scenarios in feature.definition_of_done pass end to end.
Fast User Switching restrictions produce a bounded actionable error.
Android unit tests, host component tests, builds, and git diff checks pass.
The final state documents identify limitations and the exact validation evidence.

known_risks.risk: Group Policy or secure-logon policy can disable or alter Fast User Switching and Credential Provider behavior.
known_risks.mitigation: Fail without logoff, return an actionable reason, and cover the condition in the VM matrix.

known_risks.risk: A four-digit PIN is vulnerable to online brute force.
known_risks.mitigation: Require an already paired client, use a salted verifier, constant-time comparison, a short lease, and per-client/profile rate limiting.

known_risks.risk: Profile summaries are currently refreshed mainly for the selected host and may be stale on the host-selection screen.
known_risks.mitigation: MW-PROFILE-01 adds bounded visible-host refresh and generation correlation without creating a second durable state owner.

known_risks.risk: Existing profile/session presentation can be overridden by retained, suspended, terminating, or active-stream states.
known_risks.mitigation: Define profile attention as an idle-online presentation refinement and add precedence tests.

known_risks.risk: The current working tree contains unrelated changes in files likely to be touched, including ConsoleActivity and string resources.
known_risks.mitigation: Inspect the complete diff before editing, preserve overlapping user work, and avoid broad rewrites or formatting.

before_work: Read AGENTS.md, MOONWAKER_ARCHITECTURE.md, CODEX_WORKFLOW.md, state.json, and state.md.
Verify the prompt assumptions against the current code and inspect existing dirty changes in every target file.
Set current_task_id and change exactly one ready/planned task to in_progress.
Synchronize the Current implementation state section in state.md.
after_work: Set the task to done only when its acceptance criteria are met; otherwise leave it in_progress or mark it blocked with a concrete reason.
Record summary, exact files changed, blockers, and every validation command/result in the task.
Append one history event; never rewrite or delete earlier history.
Set current_task_id to null when work ends and move next_task_id only to a dependency-ready task.
Update state.md to match state.json in the same change.
Do not store secrets, PINs, passwords, tokens, certificates, personal Windows account names beyond product examples, or raw diagnostics in either state file.
Do not commit or push unless the user explicitly requests it.
